sentences.en: The horse is the noblest conquest ever made by man.
sentences.zh: 这匹马是人类所取得的最崇高的征服。

sentences.en: Archeologically speaking, there was never any Hebrew conquest of Canaan.
sentences.zh: 从考古学的角度来说，以色列人从未征服过迦南。

sentences.en: Go is a game of dispute and conquest of territory.
sentences.zh: 围棋是一种关于争夺和领土征服的游戏。

senses.zh: 征服，击败,战利品,（尤指）爱情的俘虏,赢得（物）
